title: Press Sec destroys reporter, defends ignoring judge's ruling on immigration at DOJ's direction by AG Pam Bondi!
text:
In a recent press briefing, the Press Secretary delivered a powerful response to a reporter who questioned the administration’s decision to ignore a judge’s ruling. The Press Secretary wasted no time in providing a clear and concise explanation, backed up by facts.
The reporter’s question seemed to imply that it was not acceptable to disregard a judge’s ruling. The Press Secretary quickly turned the tables by asking, “Who does that judge work for?” The Press Secretary pointed out that the judge in question was an immigration judge who works for the Department of Justice (DOJ) at the direction of the Attorney General, Pam Bondi.
By highlighting the fact that the judge works for the DOJ, which is ultimately overseen by the Attorney General, the Press Secretary made it clear that the judge’s ruling was not the final word. The Press Secretary’s response effectively shut down any argument that the administration was in the wrong for ignoring the judge’s decision.
This exchange exemplifies the Press Secretary’s ability to handle tough questions with poise and confidence. By relying on facts and logic, the Press Secretary was able to dismantle the reporter’s argument and make a compelling case for the administration’s actions.
